caption: A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
relations: The unicycle wheel contacts the curb's edge and begins to climb over it, transferring the rider's weight upward and forward.
As the wheel rises, the rider leans slightly forward to maintain balance over the moving wheel.
The wheel clears the curb and rolls down the other side, with the rider shifting their body to stabilize the center of mass.
The rider's adjustments continue until the wheel reaches level ground and motion stabilizes.
